Class ParquetFileWriter

Namespace
ParquetNeo
Assembly
ParquetNeo.dll

Writes a Parquet file, one row group at a time. Columns are written one leaf column at a time, with the definition and repetition levels for nested ones. The stream only needs to be writable: offsets are counted rather than read from the stream, so it need not be seekable.

public sealed class ParquetFileWriter : IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable

Examples

using var writer = new ParquetFileWriter(stream, schema);
using (var group = writer.AppendRowGroup())
{
    group.NextColumn().WriteBatch(ids);
    group.NextColumn().WriteStrings(names, definitionLevels);
}

The footer is written when the writer is closed or disposed. Nothing here is thread safe.

Parameters

output Stream

A writable stream, positioned where the file should start.

The schema. Its leaf columns are written in depth-first order.

options ParquetWriterOptions

Compression, page size and footer settings; null for the defaults.

leaveOpen bool

Whether to keep output open when the writer is closed.
